# Whizbang 3.0.0 (build 20)
Local-first foundation. Whizbang now keeps your working records in an encrypted database on this Mac and reads from it first.
- Tasks, Calendar, Directory, Matters, Notes, Switchboard, Documents, Forms, Time and Training open from protected local storage before the server answers. - Edits you make while disconnected are saved on this Mac and synchronize when you reconnect, with clear "saved here / waiting to sync / confirmed" states. - Private drafts (Library, Profile, Notes, Forms, messages, Growth content) are kept encrypted and survive quit and restart. - Workspace lock hides private content immediately; offline access uses a signed seven-day grant issued by your firm. - Recovery for new task drafts, Profile edits and clean quit behaviour repaired.
